about: Records of the second-round distance search of 7 November 2026 (research branch, research/search2/distances at 2c3ce12) and of the plan's kernel (research/plan at 9932b15), copied to evidence/, with one run of this catalogue's own sweep made here. Each record is bound to its circuit by columns_sha256 (constructions.digest of the columns); label is the catalogue row at assembly, research_label the label the research used. Written by round2_certificates/assemble.py. A count record states count, the number of harmful accepted faults of the given weight, and accepted, the number of accepted ones; where two tools count one circuit, they agree.
